adapters.label: Tag Obsidian note
adapters.description: Adds safe tags to one Markdown note through the Obsidian adapter.

adapters.label: Link Obsidian note to task or report
adapters.description: Appends safe task/report reference metadata to one Markdown note.

adapters.label: MemPalace status
adapters.description: Reads MemPalace status and safe counts through the registered adapter.

adapters.label: Query MemPalace memory summary
adapters.description: Queries safe MemPalace memory summaries without returning raw private records.

adapters.label: Summarize MemPalace memory
adapters.description: Summarizes safe MemPalace memory index state without returning raw private records.

adapters.label: Remember task result in MemPalace
adapters.description: Stores a bounded owner-visible task-result memory summary through the MemPalace adapter.

adapters.label: Remember owner preference in MemPalace
adapters.description: Stores a bounded owner-visible preference summary through the MemPalace adapter.

adapters.label: Update safe MemPalace summary
adapters.description: Appends a new safe summary version for a MemPalace memory key without overwriting prior records.

adapters.label: Link MemPalace memory to task/report
adapters.description: Stores a safe audited memory link to a task and/or report through the MemPalace adapter.
